exact_signature.note: correct behaviour: the only pair sharing the query signature is in the excluded group, so a signature match has nothing to return. Precise where it fires, silent elsewhere.

vertical_slice.arms_caveat: A three-candidate pool cannot separate the arms and is not meant to. The slice proves the path executes end to end; the comparison that decides anything is the frozen 80-query benchmark of S21D1-050 to 054.

design_finding.name: canonical-hash verification of an edit path must be structural
design_finding.observed: The first round-trip attempt failed on every node. The two sides of a pair are two different runs, so the same logical step carries different authoritative evidence bytes, and a node's content hash includes that source hash.
design_finding.why_it_matters: Including provenance in the comparison would force the edit path to emit a relabel for every single node, which is noise rather than a repair suggestion, and no repair path could ever reproduce a successful graph's full content hash.
design_finding.resolution: ActionDecisionGraph.structural_hash covers the labelled structure and deliberately excludes provenance. The edit path's from and to hashes are structural, the round trip compares structural hashes, and provenance is verified separately by resolving every source hash. Backlog section 2.2 condition 12 is satisfied by a canonical hash that the transformation can actually reproduce.
design_finding.scope: affects S21D1-044 in wave W4, which inherits this definition
